title: Self-controlled case series (conditional Poisson)
summary: The incidence rate ratio in a risk window after exposure against other times in the same person, from cases only, adjusted for age.

sizing._why: SCCS sample size depends on the risk-window length relative to the observation period and the age-specific rates (Musonda 2006); no catalog form takes them.

pinned_defaults: Both: Poisson with a fixed effect per case and log(interval length) as the offset, which has the same estimate and SE as the SCCS conditional (multinomial) likelihood; age band in the model.
Python: wls_method = 'qr' in the GLM fit; the default SVD solver failed to converge on 1 of the 100 calibration fixtures.
_assumptions: Events do not change the probability of later exposure or the end of observation; recurrent events independent (or first event only). Age must be modelled: here leaving it out gives log IRR 1.66 against 1.20.
